notes:
THE THREE COMMAND FIELDS ARE LOAD-BEARING. internal/ci/workflow_test.go reads this file and .github/workflows/ci.yml and fails if they disagree: every `run:` in ci.yml must be byte-identical to build_command, lint_command or test_command here, all three must appear, and setup-go must pin the `go` directive from go.mod (currently 1.26.0). Changing a command here without editing ci.yml in the same commit breaks the suite.

Conventions: CLAUDE.md at the repo root - house rules, package boundaries, and the standing warning that a green suite is not evidence of correctness here (`go test ./...` passed with 32 review findings live, 8 critical). Record new patterns there. AGENT.md is the shipped operating manual for agents *driving the binary* (product docs, not house style), and docs/design/DESIGN.md (draft v0.5) is the SPEC - neither is a conventions file. The plan phase reads the spec; build iterations read their task slice.

Current work: branch phase-2a-remediation. tasks.json points at docs/plans/2026-08-03-phase-2a-remediation.md; docs/plans/2026-08-02-phase-2-boundary-design.md is the rationale, with 2b (boundary) and 2c (distribution) queued after.

Test layout: Go colocates tests with source, so source_dirs and test_dirs are identical. test_single_command uses command substitution - run it through a shell (bash -c), not exec'd directly. internal/canary, internal/e2e and internal/ci are test-only; internal/e2e/boundary_test.go asserts the import-graph rules from CLAUDE.md against the real package graph.

Lint: golangci-lint is NOT installed. Plain `gofmt -l .` exits 0 even on unformatted files - hence the `test -z "$(...)"` wrapper.

Second workflow: .github/workflows/hygiene.yml gates tracked files over 512KB, ralph session logs / corpora / .env-shaped paths, and credential-shaped strings (ghp_, sk-ant-, AKIA, PEM headers). Never `git add -f` a .ralph log or a recorded corpus - .gitignore is only consulted for untracked files, so a force-add stays tracked forever and keeps failing CI.

Runtime: system curl is the execution engine, hard floor curl >= 7.70 for --write-out '%{json}'. Installed here: curl 8.14.1, Go 1.26.0. No database, no services, no .env needed.

Verified 2026-08-03: build, lint, the full suite and the single-file form all run green from the repo root.
